project_type: TypeScript monorepo monster-raising web game (AIモンスター). React+Vite frontend, AWS Lambda backend, @ddm/shared pure domain logic, CDK infra.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds @ddm/shared -> @ddm/backend -> @ddm/frontend -> infra in order. PATH may need `export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"`.
test_framework: node:test with --experimental-strip-types (TS run directly). Shared tests in packages/shared/src/__tests__/*.test.ts. Frontend pure ui-helpers tests in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts.
test_command: npm test (shared, baseline 75 passing) AND npm run test -w @ddm/frontend (frontend ui-helpers, baseline 79 passing)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH for node. 2) `npm test` -> shared tests all pass (new count > 75). 3) `npm run test -w @ddm/frontend` -> ui-helpers tests all pass (new count > 79). 4) `npm run build` -> tsc typechecks all packages incl. frontend (tsc && vite build) and backend bundle; must succeed with no type errors. Grep is NOT verification; run the actual test+build commands.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null (no snapshot/generated checked-in files; backend bundles @ddm/shared at build time)
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed (node_modules present). If missing: `npm install` at root. Always `export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"` first.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Cannot push/open PRs (orchestrator does that). No new runtime dependencies allowed. Keep JA output byte-identical for existing i18n keys. Must NOT change the simulateBattle structured log line FORMAT (frontend parseBattleEvents/battleLogLine depend on `T{n}: {attacker} hits {defender} for {dmg} (enemy|player HP {hp})` and `Result: {winner}`). Do NOT touch backup/previous-main.
contribution_requirements: Branch off main (e.g. feat/battle-enhancements), well-separated commits, commit locally only. JA/EN i18n parity required or frontend build fails (EN typed Record<MessageKey,string>). Add BOTH ja+en for every new key. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any new animation. Backward compat: pre-#41 saves lack the win/loss record field; must default it (not reject in validateMonster) mirroring how #42 handled optional `affection`.
key_patterns: Shared pure functions return a NEW monster (cloneMonster), never mutate input; take `now`/`seed` params for determinism. Affection (#42) is the template to mirror: optional field on Monster with an `affectionOf`/`normalizeAffection` default helper + `validateMonster` accepting absent-or-valid. simulateBattle uses mulberry32 createRng(seed). Backend builds enemy server-side (buildEnemy) today; will switch to shared generateEnemy(playerStage, difficulty, seed). Frontend: optimistic commit -> api call -> commit. i18n `t(lang,key)` pure lookup; JA dict is source of truth for MessageKey. Reset confirm dialog in App.tsx (role=alertdialog, focus trap, Escape) is the modal/confirm accessibility pattern to reuse for the low-HP warning if a modal is added. Battle animation reconstructs enemyMaxHp in BattlePanel from stage*0.9 and enemyName from battle.enemyName template; this must be updated to use the real previewed enemy stats/name so preview==animation.

packages/shared/src/types.ts (Monster, BattleRequest/BattleResult, Stats; add Difficulty + BattleRecord types + optional record field on Monster)

packages/shared/src/game.ts (affection pattern to mirror: affectionOf/normalizeAffection/validateMonster optional-with-default; add generateEnemy/battleReward/battle-record helpers here or new module)

packages/shared/src/index.ts (barrel export; add any new exports)
packages/shared/src/__tests__/battle.test.ts (test pattern for battle sim; add generateEnemy/battleReward/record tests here or sibling file)

packages/frontend/src/api.ts (battle(monsterId) -> battle(monsterId, difficulty, seed) POST body)

packages/frontend/src/App.tsx (wire BattlePanel props; reset-confirm dialog is the accessible-modal pattern)
packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts (pure helpers + their unit tests live in game-ui.test.ts; add difficulty labels, record formatting, low-HP decision helper)

directory_structure: packages/shared/src: domain logic (battle.ts, game.ts, stages.ts, types.ts, bedrock-models.ts, index.ts) + __tests__/. packages/backend/src: handlers/ (battle, chat, getMonster, saveMonster), dynamo.ts, lib/http.ts, config.ts. packages/frontend/src: App.tsx, state/useMonster.ts, api.ts, i18n.ts, ui-helpers.ts, components/*.tsx (BattlePanel, StatsPanel, CarePanel, ChatPanel, NameDialog, etc.), assets/monsters/. infra: CDK. .agents/tasks: prior task plans.
